summary.text: Todd Johnson is a Republican state senator from North Carolina who represents District 35, covering Cabarrus and Union counties, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, against Democrat Christine Winward.
An insurance agent, he serves as Senate Majority Whip.

paragraphs.text: Johnson earned a bachelor's degree from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, according to Ballotpedia, which lists his profession as insurance agent.
He has served in the Senate since January 1, 2019.
The General Assembly's website lists Johnson as Senate Majority Whip.
He chairs the Appropriations on Agriculture, Natural, and Economic Resources and Commerce and Insurance committees and co-chairs the Joint Legislative Emergency Management Oversight Committee.
The Republican primary for his seat on March 3, 2026, was canceled.
